metadata.heading_title: Extent and Limitation of Liability of Limited Liability Partnership and Partners

heading.title: Extent and Limitation of Liability of Limited Liability Partnership and Partners

article.title: Partner as agent.
article.content:
26Partner as agent.

Section 26  ·  Chapter V  ·  page 13 of the Act
Every partner of a limited liability partnership is, for the purpose of the business of the limited liability partnership, the agent of the limited liability partnership, but not of other partners.
